recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The current build-scoped source satisfies the old request in the successor artifact; any future change to category breadth should be handled as a new CDS terminology decision rather than as a missed FHIR-7672 application.
issue_request: FHIR-7672 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU1 and asked that Contraindication.category have an actual populated value set or at least a good set of examples based on the logical value set specification.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-7672 was found. The Jira comments say the policy should be followed and then that the request had already been done. Historical source shows Contraindication.category became DetectedIssue.category through FHIR-8043, and FHIR-8336 corrected the detectedissue-category compose from an empty intersection to a union of detected-issue ActCode includes.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists DetectedIssue as an active CDS resource and notes that Contraindication became DetectedIssue. Later Applied issue FHIR-39458 intentionally split high-level DetectedIssue.category from detailed DetectedIssue.code, creating detectedissue-code and restricting detectedissue-category to explicit category concepts.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source/detectedissue/structuredefinition-DetectedIssue.xml binds DetectedIssue.category to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/detectedissue-category, and source/detectedissue/valueset-detectedissue-category.xml contains FOOD, DRUG, ALGY, and DUPTHPY v3 ActCode concepts.
